text:
Sam Lee: Hi all \u270b I'm Sam, starting today as a Site Reliability Engineer. Quick intro + setup thread. I'm remote PST but planning to drop into SF next Friday. Can someone add me to infra-config and monitoring dashboards? Also deciding whether to request a loaner M2 for local testing. Two truths & a lie: I rode a motorcycle across Vietnam, I once fixed a production incident at 3am solo, I am allergic to chocolate. Which is the lie?

Nora Kim: Welcome Sam! :tada: Adding you to #eng-sre. For dashboards, post your GitHub handle and I'll route invites. For laptop, if you're running heavy tests request the M2; otherwise personal is fine for week one.

IT Support: Hi Sam \u270b Please file hardware + access at https://redwood.internal/it-requests. If you paste your GitHub handle we can pre-stage invites and create a yubikey/VPN ticket.

Sam Lee: GitHub handle is sam-lee-sre. Quick note — tried cloning infra-config and got a permission error:

```
$ git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/infra-config.git
Cloning into 'infra-config'...
Permission denied (publickey).
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
```
Any fast tip while IT opens the ticket?

Priya Rao: run `ssh -T git@github.com` to check key. If it fails, generate an ED25519 key and add to GitHub: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "sam@redwood.ai"` then `pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`. If using agent: `eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" && ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`. Happy to screenshare for 10m.

DevEx Bot: Note: Sam Lee added to #eng-sre. Buddy assigned: Nora Kim. Onboarding checklist created: hardware pending, repo access pending.

Mia Tran: welcome Sam! If you want a short-term M2 for testing we have a checkout policy — ask IT and cc me if you need department approval. Also I call dibs on the motorcycle story at lunch.

Sam Lee: Thanks everyone \u2764\ufe0f I filed the IT request and pasted my ssh pubkey. Chocolate is definitely not the lie (sadly). Looking forward to meeting folks in SF next Friday.
